title: Morning Brief — Wed, Jul 29, 2026
summary: Iran fires ballistic missiles at a US base in Jordan for the first time since Trump's pause, all intercepted, with US-Saudi forces striking back in Iraq and oil jumping ~3.5%, hours before today's FOMC decision, Warsh press conference, and Microsoft/Meta/Arm/Qualcomm earnings; Kumamoto's death toll rises to at least 13 as chip-fab impacts stay contained, and the AI-chip/power-infrastructure selloff extends into a third session on a fresh ~6% drop in Korean chipmakers.

title: Closing Brief — Tue, Jul 28, 2026
summary: A magnitude-7.1 earthquake's toll rises to at least one dead and 100+ injured as Kyushu chipmakers TSMC and Sony disclose facility impacts, deepening a chip-and-power-infrastructure selloff (AMD -8%, Micron -9%, Vertiv -6%) on a Chinese lithography report and peak-memory-price warnings; Trump hosts Netanyahu and Zelenskyy at the White House as the FOMC's meeting begins and oil drops on Iran-Saudi Hormuz diplomacy, while Coca-Cola's Fairlife data is leaked after a ransomware deadline lapses.

title: Morning Brief — Tue, Jul 28, 2026
summary: A magnitude-7.1 earthquake strikes Kumamoto, Japan overnight while Asian chip stocks post their worst session in roughly two decades on AI-capex financing anxiety; Boeing, Royal Caribbean and Coca-Cola open earnings week with mixed results as the FOMC meeting begins and the DOJ asks the Supreme Court to lift an injunction on the administration's mail-ballot order.

title: Closing Brief — Mon, Jul 27, 2026
summary: Nvidia sheds ~5% on a report of $250B+ financing talks to fund OpenAI's data-center buildout, while the Dow and Russell 2000 hold gains and a broad defense/space cohort rallies; Iran vows retaliation against Ukraine over the weekend's Caspian Sea strike as the US-Iran pause holds a fourth day, and today's 2-Year Treasury auction shows solid demand into Wednesday's FOMC decision.

title: Morning Brief — Mon, Jul 27, 2026
summary: US-Iran pause holds a third day and oil craters ~5-7% into a week carrying the FOMC decision, four mega-cap earnings, Q2 GDP, and the FRONTIER Act; Ukraine confirms a Caspian Sea strike on an Iran-linked vessel and European wildfires force 300,000+ evacuations.

title: Week-Ahead Outlook — Week of Jul 27, 2026
summary: First edition: FOMC decides Wednesday and five mega-caps report Wed/Thu into a Q2 GDP print and an Employment Cost Index Friday, against a fragile US-Iran ceasefire.
